name: San Francisco Public Library Services
description: Free library services including digital resources, programs, and community offerings with SF library card
fullDescription: San Francisco Public Library offers a wide range of free services and programs beyond just books, including digital resources, programs, and community offerings.
whatTheyOffer:
- Digital resources (eBooks, streaming, databases)
- Free WiFi, public computer reservations, printing and scanning
- Free programs and events
- Homework help and an online high school diploma program
- Jobs and careers resources
- Social worker program, services for older adults, and Jail and Reentry Services (JARS)
- Discover & Go museum passes
howToGetIt:
1. Get a San Francisco Public Library card (free)
2. Visit sfpl.org/services
3. Explore available services
4. Many services available online or in-person
5. Some programs require registration
keywords: SFPL, San Francisco Public Library, library services, free WiFi, computers, homework help, social worker, job search, Discover & Go, reentry services, older adults
